geometry: GARMENT MOTION: retain natural wearing, purposeful steps and fabric drape. Preserve the exact garment cut, print, color and source-facing view. ORIGINAL ORIENTATION: preserve the source relationship between front, top, bottom, controls, display, openings and attachments. Never mirror, invert, mount backwards or reverse the product's functional orientation. Adapt the person, body-part pose, support and camera to the unchanged product, not the product to the scene. If the intended use requires an unverified angle or fit, choose a different truthful presentation with the original visible surfaces. This does not freeze an actor: retain natural garment wearing, gait and fabric drape while keeping cut, print and original front intact.
providerSafety: HARD PRODUCT LOCK: frame 0 defines product identity, verified view and set, not a frozen actor pose. Natural gait, head/eye motion and fabric response are allowed within the approved action. Never rotate the product, flip, orbit or reveal unverified surfaces. PHYSICAL SUBJECT LOCK: printed pictures and screen depictions remain static artwork, never physical scene objects. COMPONENT ROLE LOCK: preserve component count, geometry, role, attachment, state, material and color. Independent stationary accessories stay fixed and separate. SURFACE PRINT LOCK: preserve every logo, letter, number and printed detail character-for-character. No redraw, invented branding, overlay text or watermarks. LIGHT AND EFFECT LOCK: no new lights, displays, glows or product effects. FUNCTION LOCK: only the bounded movement specified below is allowed; never activate, open, dock, insert, transform or repurpose parts. SCENE CONTINUITY LOCK: one continuous shot; no cuts, new product-facing perspective, pop-in, duplication, extra limbs or unexplained motion. Tracking may move the background only while the verified product view stays unchanged. Preserve initial conditions, physical support and product count.
